dedicated.name: Skuld's Spindle of Destiny

why_by_stat.EffectHit: Helps Skuld's effects overcome the enemy’s Effect Resistance, increasing the chance that those effects can successfully occur.

dedicated.story:
A great war broke out in the Celestial Realm, and like so many others, the Three Sisters of Fate received a call to arms summoning them to battle.
Possessing the gift of foresight, Skuld, the youngest, sensed something ominous was at hand and objected. However, her two older sisters decided to fight on behalf of their realm. Tragically, both of Skuld's sisters lost their lives in the war, and she was left to drown in grief, all alone. But one day, Skuld stumbled upon a spinning wheel and a letter —a birthday gift left behind by her sisters— and was able to feel the depth of their love once more, guiding her way back to happiness.

lore: In a time preceding the war of the Celestial Realm, Skuld and her sisters were known as the Three Sisters of Fate — the eldest overseeing the past, the second overseeing the present, and Skuld overseeing the future. However, she lost both of her sisters during the Celestial War and was subsequently rescued by Freyja, after which she joined forces with her to establish the Celestial Guardians. In the years that followed, even while occasionally aiding Freyja with her prophecies, she staunchly maintained the stance of a detached observer, refraining from becoming too deeply involved in the day-to-day affairs of the Celestial Guardians.
